info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Fiduciary Agreement Management API
info.description: The Fiduciary Agreement Management API facilitates the creation and management of fiduciary agreements between clients and financial institutions. This API allows users to initiate new agreements, ensuring regulatory compliance and transparency in financial operations. Typical consumers include banking institutions and financial service providers looking to streamline their fiduciary agreement processes. By offering a structured approach to agreement management, the API enhances operational efficiency and client satisfaction.

post.summary: Create a fiduciary agreement for deposit lending.
post.description: Initiate a new fiduciary agreement within the deposit lending service. This endpoint allows you to establish a fiduciary relationship that governs the handling and management of deposit funds.
